summary: Ran backend pytest + frontend Playwright for storefront search persistence, customer My Orders/detail/invoice ownership, admin order management, and auth playbook checks. Core order and admin workflows pass; two auth/security regressions remain.

critical.issue: CORS preflight from preview origin still returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' instead of credentialed success with explicit allow-origin.
Brute-force lockout policy does not enforce lockout after 5 failed attempts; valid password succeeds immediately (200) on 6th attempt.

integration_issues.flow: Storefront and admin page loads while logged out/session-switching
integration_issues.issue: Browser console repeatedly logs 401 for /api/auth/me before auth is established; flow still works but console is noisy.

action_items: Fix auth CORS preflight for credentialed preview origin on /api/auth/login OPTIONS.
Align lockout behavior with requirement: enforce temporary block after 5 failed logins before allowing valid credentials.
Optional: suppress expected unauthenticated /api/auth/me console noise during startup/session transitions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login path intentionally bypasses lockout for valid credentials (commented logic around lines ~639-648), which conflicts with stated brute-force lockout requirement.
Auth CORS mismatch persists despite allow_origin_regex + allow_origins config; runtime Origin matching/ingress header handling should be reviewed.
backend/server.py remains monolithic and high-risk for regressions when touching auth/order logic.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST users during lockout/hash/invoice-ownership checks; created one empty-state customer via UI registration and one lockout test account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: search query IPHONE XR stayed exact and stable after >3s live sync; /my-orders auth guard redirect; empty-state for no-order user; existing-customer order card/detail/timeline/help path; invoice endpoint owner/admin allow + unrelated user blocked; admin /admin/orders search + drawer open/update/save and restore original status/tracking. Remaining fails are auth preflight and lockout only.
rca of the issue: (1) CORS preflight reproduces with OPTIONS /api/auth/login using Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com, returning 400 Disallowed CORS origin. (2) Lockout reproduces with fresh account: 5 wrong passwords return 401; immediate valid login returns 200 instead of 429, indicating policy bypass in current login logic.
